name: NIKOLA MD
description: NIKOLA MD — WhatsApp bot with session-ID-based pairing. Generate SESSION_ID at the pair site, paste into Heroku/Render, bot comes online.

SESSION_ID.description: Get this from https://nikolamd.pairsite.space — format: NIKOLA MD:<20-char-code> (30 chars total). Required for the bot to come online.

SELF_URL.description: Your app's public URL (e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com). The bot uses this to fetch its full session. Set to your Heroku app URL.

MASTER_PASSWORD.description: Password for the pair site dashboard (not needed if you only run the bot). Default: nikola-md-internal.
